asset_prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium production Linux desktop wallpaper for Toddy OS, landscape 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Brand direction: MIDNIGHT NAVY, elegant, calm, confident, with personality but not cute. Edge-to-edge sculptural folded fabric-like waves or satin paper ribbons in midnight #081426, deep navy #10233F, ocean blue #24518A and a single restrained icy blue highlight. The curves can subtly echo the soft drooping ears of a Shih-tzu without drawing a dog or any literal object. Composition: broad quiet dark navy negative space across left two thirds for desktop windows, softly illuminated overlapping folds concentrated at bottom right; exquisite controlled lighting, matte tactile surfaces, subtle fine texture, restrained depth, no bright bloom. Suitable as a real GNOME wallpaper, luxurious editorial simplicity. NO text, NO logo, NO mascot, NO dog, NO interface, NO icons, NO stars, NO circuits, NO neon, NO watermark, NO border, NO mockup. Keep the environment predominately blue, no beige, brown or purple.

Use case: lighting-weather. Create the LIGHT THEME companion wallpaper to this exact Toddy OS dark wallpaper. Preserve the broad elegant flowing ribbon composition and tactile matte subtle fabric texture. Replace the navy background with a very pale cool blue-white #EFF5FC, folds in restrained mist blue #D4E4F5 and slate blue #8DAED1, and only a small deep navy accent at the far lower right. Broad clean negative space on left two thirds, quiet gently illuminated relief, premium GNOME wallpaper. It must read as the light variant of the same identity. Landscape 16:9. No text, no logos, no mascot, no dog, no interface or watermark, no beige, brown or purple.

Use case: lighting-weather. Make a BOOT AND LOGIN companion background for the supplied Toddy OS navy wallpaper, wide landscape 16:9. Keep the midnight navy palette and subtle fine matte texture. Simplify dramatically: mostly solid near-black navy #081426, with just a very soft broad blue sculptural ribbon following the bottom edge and lower right corner. Leave the central 70 percent extremely calm and empty for real login controls and the original Toddy logo added by the OS. No bright line through the center, no spotlight. Premium restrained coherent companion to the input. NO logo, NO dog, NO mascot, NO letters, NO progress bar, NO fake interface, NO watermark, NO beige or purple. This is only an empty background, not a mockup.

Use case: compositing. Asset: an actual Toddy OS desktop wallpaper, not a mockup. Image 1 is the existing navy wallpaper EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is the approved transparent Toddy Shih-tzu mascot INSERT, not a style suggestion. Preserve the existing background composition, midnight navy palette, blue folds and quiet negative space. Add a precise faithful reproduction of the supplied original mascot on the right third, center at about 80% canvas width and 44% canvas height; mascot about 21% of canvas height, subtle and crisp, not huge. Preserve its chestnut and ivory fur, short muzzle, glasses, eyes, expression, head angle and outlines; do not redesign or recolor the mascot. Below it place small refined cool-white sans-serif text exactly 'Toddy OS', with generous breathing room. Keep left two thirds empty for desktop windows. No rectangle or badge behind the logo, no glow or drop shadow on the mascot, no added slogan, no other text, no desktop icons, no dock, no windows, no border, no watermark. Landscape 16:9, preserve the original premium subdued navy artwork. This is a clean branded wallpaper export.
